overview: The Council reviewed proposals regarding a potential private partnership to place a seasonal dome over Edgerly Field and addressed chronic sidewalk parking and commercial trash issues in South Medford. Members also accepted a $4,500 health grant for senior farm shares and approved resolutions concerning municipal lead pipe replacement and school facility accounting.

items.title: One Mission Buzz Off Cancer Fundraiser
items.summary: Teachers and community members presented on the upcoming One Mission Buzz Off at Gillette Stadium honoring deceased student Himo Redati, prompting the Council to request that the mayor promote the event on the Interstate 93 electronic billboard.

items.title: Hallmark Health Grant for Produce in a Snap for Seniors
items.summary: The Council approved the acceptance of an unconditional $4,500 gift from Hallmark Health Corporation to subsidize farm shares for Medford seniors through the Medford Farmers Market and Mass in Motion.

items.title: Taxi Vehicle Upgrade: Metric Cab
items.summary: The Council approved a vehicle upgrade petition for Metric Cab, while a separate petition for Citywide Taxi was temporarily tabled due to the applicant's absence.

items.title: Chevalier Theatre Management and Production Interest
items.summary: Civic Auditorium Commission Treasurer John Costas notified the Council of interest from North Shore Music Theatre to produce shows and invest in the venue, and the communication was received and placed on file ahead of commission and subcommittee meetings.

items.title: Edgerly Field Dome Proposal and Maintenance History
items.summary: Following debate over a proposed seasonal bubble over Edgerly Field and deferred turf maintenance, the Council passed an amended resolution requesting the School Committee provide a draft copy of its updated request for proposals, past maintenance funding records, and a business plan.

items.title: South Medford Sidewalk Parking and Traffic Enforcement
items.summary: Residents and officials discussed commercial delivery trucks driving and parking on sidewalks, early morning dumpster noise, and traffic hazards in South Medford, culminating in an approved request for police reports on sidewalk parking policies and citation counts.

items.title: Taxi Vehicle and Operator Licenses
items.summary: The Council approved a vehicle upgrade for Citywide Taxi and granted a taxi driver license to Philippe M. Tovar.

items.title: School Department Out-of-State Residency Inquiry
items.summary: A motion requesting a list of school department employees residing out of state for six months or more failed.

items.title: Accounting of School Facilities Rental and Revenue
items.summary: The Council voted to table a resolution requesting an accounting of groups using school facilities for free or for fee payments and where those funds are deposited.

items.title: Veterans Advisory Committee Appointments
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting the names of mayoral appointees to the Veterans Advisory Committee, with members reading several confirmed appointees into the record.

items.title: Field of Dreams Financial Accounting
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting a three-year accounting of profits, losses, and bond terms for the Field of Dreams athletic fields.

items.title: Medford High School Pool Financial Accounting
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting a financial accounting of profits, losses, and bond terms associated with the Medford High School swimming pool.

items.title: MWRA Lead Service Line Replacement Loan Program
items.summary: The Council voted to refer the Massachusetts Water Resources Authority's new zero-percent interest lead service line replacement loan program to the City Engineer to determine whether the city will participate.

items.title: DPW Crosswalk Repainting Requests
items.summary: The Council approved an amended resolution requesting the Department of Public Works repaint designated crosswalks along Salem Street, around public schools, and across the city.

items.title: Commendation and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating Sophie Santoro on her 90th birthday and approved the minutes of the previous meeting.
